description: Process water transfer pump, building 2. Duty pump; P-102 is standby. End-suction centrifugal pump driven by a 7.5 kW motor through a flexible coupling; inlet isolation gate valve; discharge riser with pressure gauge; wall-mounted control box with isolator.

partNotes.Baseplate: Fabricated steel baseplate, grouted to the plinth. Check hold-down bolts at 85 Nm.
partNotes.Motor: 7.5 kW induction motor, 1450 rpm. Drives the pump through a flexible coupling.
partNotes.Coupling: Flexible jaw coupling and bearing housing between the motor and the pump shaft. Alignment tolerance 0.05 mm.
partNotes.Pump: End-suction centrifugal pump. Rated 42 m³/h at 32 m head.
partNotes.Outlet: Discharge to the process header. Normal pressure 3.2 bar.
partNotes.Gate valve: Inlet isolation gate valve. Closes clockwise; 14 turns from fully open.
partNotes.Inlet pipe: DN100 suction line from the supply tank.
partNotes.Control box: Motor starter and isolator for P-101. STOP is the red button; the isolator locks in OFF.
partNotes.Workbench: Service bench. Seal kits and gaskets live in the top drawer.

steps.title: Stop and lock out
steps.body: Press STOP, then lock the isolator in the OFF position.

steps.title: Close this valve
steps.body: Turn the handwheel clockwise until it stops.

steps.title: Check the shaft is still
steps.body: Confirm the coupling has stopped before removing the guard.

steps.title: Open the inlet valve
steps.body: Turn the handwheel anticlockwise until fully open.

steps.title: Prime the casing
steps.body: Vent the casing until water runs clear.

steps.title: Start the motor
steps.body: Remove your lock, switch the isolator ON and press START.

steps.title: Check discharge pressure
steps.body: The gauge should settle near 3.2 bar within ten seconds.

records.title: Bearing over-temperature
records.detail: 82 °C at the drive-end bearing; tripped on thermal overload.
